in_sanskrit.name: Bava
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord, God, Master
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Bava एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। One who is the master of all, the supreme lord, the god. This name is often used to refer to Lord Krishna or Lord Shiva.

in_hindi.name: Bava
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord, God, Master
in_hindi.long_meaning: Bava एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। One who is the master of all, the supreme lord, the god. This name is often used to refer to Lord Krishna or Lord Shiva.

in_tamil.name: Bava
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் Lord, God, Master
in_tamil.long_meaning: Bava ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। One who is the master of all, the supreme lord, the god. This name is often used to refer to Lord Krishna or Lord Shiva.

in_telugu.name: Bava
in_telugu.meaning: హిందూ పేరు అంటే Lord, God, Master
in_telugu.long_meaning: Bava ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। One who is the master of all, the supreme lord, the god. This name is often used to refer to Lord Krishna or Lord Shiva.

in_marathi.name: Bava
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord, God, Master
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bava हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who is the master of all, the supreme lord, the god. This name is often used to refer to Lord Krishna or Lord Shiva.
